    StartersDoubloon cheese coinsCrisp cheddar shortbread coins with smoked paprika and a little cayenneHow to make it80g butter150g plain flour150g vintage cheddar1 pinch smoked paprika1 pinch cayenne pepperGrate the cheddar. Rub the butter into the flour, add the cheese, smoked paprika and cayenne and bring together.Roll into a log and chill.Slice into coins and bake at 180°C until golden.Astoria clam chowder cupsCreamy clam and potato chowder in mugs, straight from the Astoria docksHow to make it1kg fresh clams (vongole), purged4 bacon rashers, diced1 onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced500g potatoes, diced2 tbsp plain flour500ml milk250ml thickened cream2 bay leaves1 packet oyster crackersSteam the clams in a covered pot with 250ml water for 4 to 5 minutes until open, then strain and keep the liquid. Pick out the meat and throw away any that stay shut.Fry the bacon in a large pot until crisp, then add the onion and celery and soften for 5 minutes.Stir in the flour, then the clam liquid, milk, potatoes and bay leaves.Simmer gently for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.Stir in the cream and clam meat and heat through without boiling. Season with pepper.Serve in mugs with oyster crackers.MainsFratelli family pizzaThin crust pizza with Italian sausage, mushrooms, mozzarella and garlic tomato sauceHow to make it500g pizza dough200g crushed tomatoes1 garlic clove1 tsp dried oregano3 Italian sausages150g mushrooms250g mozzarellaHeat a pizza steel in the oven at its maximum.Mix the tomatoes with crushed garlic and oregano. Squeeze the sausage from its skins, slice the mushrooms and grate the mozzarella.Stretch the dough into two thin bases and top with sauce, sausage, mushrooms and cheese.Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat.Goon Docks crispy fish tacosRosalita and the marble bagHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flathead in a crunchy soda water batter, piled into warm tortillas with chipotle slaw, pickled onion, avocado and lime, a pirate map's worth of crunch.Pickle 1 sliced red onion in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes.Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tsp chipotle in adobo.Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold soda water and salt.Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip and fry at 180°C for 3 minutes.Warm 12 flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, sliced avocado and lime.SweetsPirate ship treasure chest cakeChocolate loaf cake hollowed out and filled with chocolate coins, under ganacheHow to make it250g dark chocolate150g butter3 eggs150g caster sugar150g self-raising flour200g chocolate coins100ml thickened creamMelt part of the chocolate with the butter, whisk in the eggs and sugar and fold in the flour.Bake in a loaf tin at 170°C.Cool the cake completely.Cut off the top and hollow out the middle, fill with chocolate coins and replace the lid.Heat the cream, pour over the remaining chocolate to make ganache, cool slightly and cover the cake.Chunk's chocolate trufflesDark chocolate cream truffles rolled in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinklesHow to make it150ml thickened cream250g dark chocolate20g butter3 tbsp cocoa60g peanuts2 tbsp sprinkles, to coatChop the chocolate. Heat the cream and pour over the chocolate and butter. Stir smooth.Chill until firm.Crush the peanuts. Scoop and roll into balls, then coat in cocoa, peanuts or sprinkles.Sloth's peanut caramel nougat barsSloth: "Ruth, Ruth, Ruth! Baby Ruth!"How to make itAs written, serves 4Chewy peanut nougat and salted caramel loaded with roasted peanuts, dipped in milk chocolate and cut into fat bars, the way Sloth would want them.Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter and 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter, then stir through 150g roasted peanuts and press into a lined 20cm tin.Melt 200g soft caramels with 2 tbsp cream and a pinch of salt and pour over.Chill 1 hour.Cut into 12 bars, dip in 300g melted milk chocolate and set on baking paper in the fridge for 30 minutes.DrinksChunk's root beer floatVanilla ice cream topped with root beer until it foams, served with long spoonsHow to make it4 x 375ml cans of root beer8 scoops of vanilla ice creamPut two scoops of ice cream in each of four tall glasses.Pour root beer slowly over each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.
